seite.einleitung: Seven fictional board members with different areas of expertise debate your question live and respond to each other's contributions. {{vorsitz}} moderates and closes with a synthesis. To find out whether it is worth applying for a particular job, use “Check job (Advisory Board)” in the job's “Create documents” card.

schluessel.text_chatgpt: Without a key, the Advisory Board debates through your ChatGPT subscription (Codex), so no key is needed. An OpenAI key unlocks OpenAI as a separate engine and is billed separately through the OpenAI API. The key is stored only on this computer, outside the program folder. Leave a field empty to keep the saved key unchanged.
schluessel.text_claude: Without a key, the Advisory Board debates through your Claude subscription, so no key is needed. An Anthropic key entered here replaces the subscription, and an OpenAI key unlocks OpenAI as an engine. The keys are stored only on this computer, outside the program folder. Leave a field empty to keep the saved key unchanged.
schluessel.gespeichert: Saved. The keys are stored only on this computer, outside the program folder.
